### A Few Principles on Civil Disobedience
Author: Paul Carter
Site: The Gospel Coalition Canada
URL: https://ca.thegospelcoalition.org/columns/ad-fontes/a-few-principles-on-civil-disobedience/
Passage: Acts 5:29
Points:
- Christians may only disobey governing authorities when human law directly conflicts with God's clear commands.
- Standing on biblical conviction never gives believers license to insult or dishonor civil leaders.
- Obeying God rather than people excludes resisting arrest or engaging in violence against officials.
- Earthly punishments imposed by authorities should be accepted peacefully with Christian joy.
- Legitimate biblical disobedience must persist in doing what God commanded even after punishment.
